description.zh: 加入集群的密码机实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the HSM instance to be added to the cluster.

descriptions.zh:
- 只有已初始化（INITIALIZED）状态的集群可加入新的密码机实例。
- 待加入集群的密码机实例状态为已启用或未启用，且未初始化。
descriptions.en:
- Only clusters in the initialized (INITIALIZED) state can have new HSM instances added.
- The HSM instance to be added to the cluster must be in the enabled or disabled state and must not be initialized.
